Definition
[two-nonnegative algebraic curvature operator] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0133 1. ch11:11.37\group Positive Curvature Operators An operator $R\in \mathcal A_n$ is two-nonnegative if the sum of every two distinct eigenvalues is nonnegative, and two-positive if all these sums are positive. Write $\mathcal C$ for the closed convex cone of two-nonnegative operators.
